choiceFireblocksDescription: The next step asks for an API key and a private key.
pemHint: Paste the PEM. The custodian service on this machine calls Fireblocks with it.
pemStoredHint: The custodian service already accepted a private key for this API key. Leave the field empty to reuse it, or paste a new PEM.
credentialsStayInBrowser: This page sends the API key and private key to the local custodian service. It does not call the Fireblocks API.
walletsEmpty: No recognized Stellar asset wallets were returned.
walletsHint: Only assets this payment app recognizes are listed. Choosing a wallet locks this list until the session is open.
errorInvalidPem: That private key could not be imported.
errorBrowserBlocked: The custodian service could not be reached. The payment app stayed closed.

errorInvalidResponse: Fireblocks returned a response Arcane could not read. The payment app stayed closed.
errorIncompleteList: Fireblocks did not finish the asset wallet list. The payment app stayed closed.
errorKeyStore: The custodian service has no signing key for this API key. The payment app stayed closed.
errorFireblocks: Fireblocks could not be reached. The payment app stayed closed.
errorCatalogMismatch: XLM_TEST does not match catalog XLM with no issuer. The payment app stayed closed.
